name: SharePoint Online Downloader
description: Downloads a file, or every file in a folder, from a SharePoint Online document library to the Omniscope server, ready for an Append files block to load.
introductoryText:
![Sharepoint Online connector](data:image/png;base64,)

Downloads a file, or every file in a folder, from a SharePoint Online document library through Microsoft Graph, and outputs one record per file with its path on the Omniscope server.

**How to set it up**: register an app in Microsoft Entra ID with the Microsoft Graph *application* permission Sites.Read.All (or Sites.Selected, with access granted to the site), have an administrator grant consent, and create a client secret. Enter the tenant ID, the app's client ID and the secret, and paste the address of the file or folder from the browser.

To load the files' contents, connect the output to an **Append files** block set to use the file paths from the upstream block (the *File path* field).

options.name: tenantId
options.title: Tenant ID
options.description: Your Microsoft Entra tenant: its ID (a GUID) or a domain such as contoso.onmicrosoft.com.

options.name: clientId
options.title: Client ID
options.description: The application (client) ID of the app registered in Microsoft Entra ID.

options.name: clientSecret
options.title: Client secret
options.description: A client secret value of that app (Certificates & secrets). Secrets expire; create a new one when sign-in starts failing.

options.name: fileUrl
options.title: File or folder URL
options.description: The address of a file or folder in a document library, as shown in the browser, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Finance/Shared Documents/Reports/budget.xlsx. A folder downloads every file in it (not sub-folders).

options.name: localFolder
options.title: Download to folder
options.description: A folder on the Omniscope server to save the files in (created if missing; files of the same name are replaced). Empty: the block's own working folder.

blockOutputs.label: Files
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per downloaded file: File path (on the Omniscope server), File name, Size (bytes), Modified (in SharePoint, UTC) and SharePoint URL.
